chunks: And in it, that the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: Indeed, Allah, the Exalted, did not grant Satan authority over the believers except over those who follow him.
And He made for them a devil within them who embellishes falsehood for them and incites them to corruption.
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for Satan having authority over believers according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq contextualizes this teaching within the Shia doctrine of *al-wilayah al-shari'ah*, emphasizing that Satan's dominion is not coercive but persuasive, relying on human free will to accept his whispers. This conditional authority underscores the believer's capacity to resist corruption through conscious adherence to divine guidance, distinguishing between those who are merely tempted and those who are truly led astray by their choices.
